status: Local implementation authorized; no release approval
source: Robert's direction (2026-11-08) after Claude's hand-priced late-game/Arena review of all 30 Ascendancies flagged Totemist and Artillerist as runaway scalers and Trapmaster, Reaver, Bladedancer, Blademaster, Cardsharp and Deathwish as flat or weak. No player decks, fights or exports; no simulations.
basis: Decision 685. Totemist: no opening 1 Spirit / 8 Barrier; Cultivation gives at most 5 Spirit a fight. Artillerist: +2 Might on its first 6 turns only (12 total), 6 Barrier on first Attack unchanged. Trapmaster: 2 more Trap slots (5), draw 1 + 2 Barrier per Trap kept, Traps +5% damage per own Trap sprung before it this fight, up to +50%. Reaver: also +1 Might on the first own HP payment each turn (a more distinctive design is still wanted). Bladedancer: Daggers +10% per Dagger played before it this turn, up to +50%, resets each turn. Blademaster: first Sword each turn also gives +1 Keen after resolving, from 1 up to 5. Cardsharp: Full Trick also gives 1 Might. Deathwish: bonus keeps growing below 40% HP to +40% at 10% (was flat +25%). Hand-priced with docs/14_CARD_COSTING.md; grades below are review signals, not measured results. Rules 96 restarts unfinished battle checkpoints. Decision 686: Sage also draws 1 on its first Serene exit each turn, and Enlightenment gives 1 Might on its first 5 such exits and 1 Bracing on the first 3. Sunwalker Dawn: 2 Might on each of its first 5 Radiant entries (10 total); Radiant frequency and the Fervor return cap of 4 unchanged.
target: Arena first: distinct competitive styles at1000HP; typical10+ own turns. Drago optimized-deck target roughly50% or somewhat above, pending representative human/deck evidence.

corrections: The A+/C+ letters used in the 2026-11-08 chat review were hand estimates. This snapshot records them as review signals only.
Preserve all earlier assessments; no simulations, measured win rates or parity certification.

mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed totems, Spirit, Auras and commands
mixedBuilds.assessment: Shaman bases gain a third starting totem; other classes need acquired plants. Existing Hawk's Dive remains playable, but future normal offers omit it. Growth depends on draw, setup and row management; no guaranteed rare combinations.

mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed Barrier, sustain, traps and Consume
mixedBuilds.assessment: No native sustain changes. On Shaman, faster kills may reduce HP loss; prioritizing plants can still displace defense. Opening and turns11+ recovery remain unmeasured.

mixedBuilds.name: Freely mixed elemental attacks, summons and weapons
mixedBuilds.assessment: Shaman gains passive starting damage without increasing Mana or changing Attack coefficients. Other class engines unchanged; no free starting Thunderbird from merely acquiring a Shaman card.

evaluationScope: Campaign I-III starter survival, IV-VII setup, VIII-X consistency, XI-XII finale; fight turns1-3,6-10 and11+. Arena1000HP equal seats; improved Shaman starting pressure without measured parity. Chip reduction from faster kills is an inference, not a measured result.
